meta.source: 2026 인싸이트러닝 회사소개서 (PDF, 26 slides) — colors sampled from the rendered slides

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Insight Navy — the brand color. Section blocks, cover fields, process chevrons, table headers, chart bars, title rules, emphasized Korean subtitles. Text on `surface`, `surface-card`, `surface-tile` (13.6:1).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Accent on navy only: eyebrows (COMPANY PROFILE 2026), highlighted words in headlines, labels inside `NavyPanel`, the short rule under panel titles, the 02 section block, diagnostic chevrons. 7.4:1 on `navy`. Never text on white (1.8:1).

tokens.name: chart-blue
tokens.usage: Second chart series (분야별 비중, 과정별 실적) beside `navy` bars, and the year labels on light cards (2023-2024). Source value is 2.6:1 on white — use only at 20px+ or for bars, keep body text in ink tokens.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Row-header column of level tables (임원 / 부장 / 팀장…) under a `navy` top row. White text on it is 5.0:1.

tokens.name: ink-navy
tokens.usage: English card titles on light cards (Enterprise Experience, Performance Management, IT Technical & Application). 11.9:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Slide headlines and display titles (ABOUT COMPANY) on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Stat numbers (2014, 10+), card titles in Korean, text on `sky` chevrons. 11:1 on `surface-tile`.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body copy and bullet lists on `surface` (7:1) and `surface-tile` (6.1:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary values in key–value lists (회사명 → 인싸이트러닝(주)) and captions on `surface-card` (5.4:1).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Chart axis ticks and English subtitles under Korean titles (Strength). Source value is 2.5:1 on white — decorative or 24px+ only, never body copy.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Slide and page background.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Rounded content cards (기획·전략, 고객사 비전/전략 확인), stat cards, the contact card.

tokens.name: surface-tile
tokens.usage: Timeline cards, client-industry rows and the small competency tags.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Header bands of strength cards and the table-of-contents captions.

tokens.name: tint-sky
tokens.usage: The one highlighted card in a row (2026~ 프로젝트 확대) and highlighted phrases. `navy` text on it is 11.4:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list sections, table cell borders, chart gridlines.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and logo on `navy` and `steel`.

families.sans: Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Section openers (ABOUT COMPANY, OUR SERVICE, OUR EXPERIENCE). Uppercase English, `ink` on white or `on-navy` on navy.

styles.name: section-number
styles.usage: Two-digit number inside the section block.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The one centered message per slide, `ink`.

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: Top-left slide label above the double rule.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: 니즈 진단부터 성과 평가까지, 교육의 전 과정을 하나의 프로젝트로 관리합니다.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Large figures in stat cards and navy panels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase category labels (OUTPUT, PARTNERS, TECH / MANUFACTURING).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge, gap inside a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and its subtitle; between bullets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tags; chevron overlap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Navy panel padding; headline to subtitle block.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Headline block to slide content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Slide side margin on a 1440px canvas.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Section blocks, navy feature panels, chevrons, tables — the brand's square shapes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Competency tags and certification chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Light content cards and stat cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large navy summary panels (TOTAL PROGRAM, PARTNERS).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Icon discs and program-category circles.

stroke.note: Line weights for rules and dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, table borders, chart gridlines in `line`.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: The long thin part of the slide-title rule and column dividers, in `navy`.

tokens.name: stroke-rule-bold
tokens.usage: The short thick segment that starts every slide-title rule (150px wide), and the bar atop job-competency columns.
